mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 0.5% quarter-over-quarter signals stronger household demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline in periods where GDPC1 accelerates >0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tight labor markets, which increases wage pressure and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE <5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below -0.5% signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO < -0.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 1-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 100,000 signals robust labor market expansion, which increases wage pressure and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates rise.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when PAYEMS > 100,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) below 1,000,000 units signals weakening residential investment, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the subsequent 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when HOUST < 1,000,000 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 2-month acceleration in the unemployment rate above 6.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which reduces wage pressure and inflation expectations, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as discount rates fall.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline when UNRATE > 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05).
